vocab.example: Please add your phone number to your email signature.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy thêm số điện thoại vào chữ ký email của bạn.

vocab.example: Try to keep your emails concise, so people can read them quickly.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy cố viết email ngắn gọn để mọi người đọc nhanh.

vocab.example: I had more than fifty emails in my inbox this morning.
vocab.example_vi: Sáng nay tôi có hơn năm mươi email trong hộp thư đến.

vocab.meaning_vi: đánh dấu (email) để xử lý sau
vocab.example: I always flag important emails so I don't forget to reply.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi luôn đánh dấu các email quan trọng để không quên trả lời.

vocab.example: I am writing regarding the meeting room booking for Friday.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi viết email này về việc đặt phòng họp cho thứ Sáu.

vocab.example: Please add the new staff to the HR distribution list.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy thêm nhân viên mới vào danh sách nhận thư của phòng nhân sự.

vocab.example: I have attached last month's report for your reference.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã đính kèm báo cáo tháng trước để bạn tham khảo.

vocab.example: Please hold off on sending the email until the manager approves it.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy tạm chưa gửi email cho đến khi quản lý duyệt.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Hi Tuấn, do you have a minute? Can you check my email to the training partner?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Office Manager)
lines.text: Sure. Hmm, it is quite long. Try to make it more concise, maybe five or six lines.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Admin Officer)
lines.text: OK. How should I start it? I wrote 'I want to ask about the training'.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Office Manager)
lines.text: Better to write 'I am writing regarding the English training in November'.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Got it. I also want to attach the staff list. What should I say?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Office Manager)
lines.text: Just say 'I have attached the staff list for your reference'. Simple and polite.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Should I send it to the whole office distribution list?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Office Manager)
lines.text: No, only to the partner and me. And please hold off until Ms. Hà confirms the budget.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Understood. I will flag it and send it after she replies.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Office Manager)
lines.text: Perfect. Oh, and update your signature. Your old title is still there.

questions.q: What is Tuấn's first advice about the email?
Why should Thảo wait before sending the email?
options: Ms. Hà must confirm the budget.
The staff list is not ready.

questions.q: What is wrong with Thảo's signature?
options: It shows her old job title.

Just a quick follow-up on my email from Monday about the training schedule.
Could you reply by Thursday so we can confirm the booking with the hotel?
Thank you for your quick response, I really appreciate your help with this.
